summary: Curaleaf filed an 8-K disclosing a Notice of Variation to its August 18, 2026 take-over bid for all Aurora Cannabis common shares. Consideration was amended to US$1.00 cash plus 0.4013 subordinate voting shares per share, and the expiry extended from December 1 to December 4, 2026. The bid targets all outstanding shares plus rights-plan rights; Curaleaf filed amendments to its Schedule 14D-1F and F-80 registration statements. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. Watch for Aurora's rights plan litigation, minimum-tender condition, and share-price spread to the cash-plus-stock consideration.
